Class JSONUtils.JSONGeneratorExtended

public class JSONUtils.JSONGeneratorExtended

Helper class for generating JSON from Salesforce SObjects. Facilitates mapping SObject field values to JSON structure with support for nested paths and field transformations. Inverse operation of SObjectExtended.

public void nestToObject(String tokenPath)

Nests all existing JSON fields under a new parent object at the specified path. Useful for wrapping the current JSON structure within a higher hierarchy level.

Parameters:
    tokenPath – The path where the current JSON should be nested (e.g., "wrapper/data").

Since:
    05/21/2017

public void writeField(JSONUtils.MappingField mapping)

Writes a field to the JSON structure using mapping configuration. Retrieves the value from the SObject record and places it at the mapped JSON path.

Parameters:
    mapping – Field mapping configuration specifying source field and target JSON path.

public void writeField(
  String fieldPath,
  Object value
)

Writes a field to the JSON structure at the specified path. Supports nested path notation (e.g., "customer/address/city").

Parameters:
    fieldPath – The JSON path where the value should be written.
    value – The value to write at the specified path.

private Map<String, Object> writeField(
  String tokenPath,
  Object value,
  Map<String, Object> partial,
  Boolean initial
)

Internal recursive method to write a field value at a nested path in the JSON structure. Creates intermediate objects as needed when using path notation.

Parameters:
    tokenPath – The JSON path (may contain '/') where the value should be written.
    value – The value to write.
    partial – The current level of the JSON map being processed.
    initial – Whether this is the initial call (true) or a recursive call (false).

Returns:
    Updated map with the new field value added.
